name: 01 Warm Iron
note: 60s profile at neutral macros: early, soft saturation, clearly warm with a noticeable bass loss. 1-%-THD anchor at −14 dBFS.

name: 02 Tight Coil
note: 80s profile at neutral macros: tight and punchy with less low-bass loss. 1-%-THD anchor at −8 dBFS.

name: 03 Open Core
note: 00s profile at neutral macros: open, saturation only at high levels (Fröhlich core with C1 high-field continuation). 1-%-THD anchor at −2 dBFS. The exponent has no effect with the Fröhlich family.

name: 04 Linear Reference
note: Linear reference: no saturation, no remanence. Macros stay ineffective for this profile (profile constants are 0); the network (bass, load/source, HF corner) still acts.
